explain: Sol's checkpoint-2 review: the production frame keeps a scope-bearing fact at its own location (the agreement rule of plan section 5), where the layout experiment's frame gave the conclusion a fresh location variable. A query literal stands at the query's ambient, and the view drops a scope fact of another ambient, so Q2 and Q4 test the exclusion. The frame itself is tested by a harness-built GK input: Q1's input (the kitchen fact kept) with the final question asked at the hall. The production frame gives Unknown there; the same input with the experiment's frame (a fresh location in the conclusion and the blocker) gives Yes. Those two inputs are diagnostic rows, not queries of this case.
